title: ( Can You Please Just Stay?!)
description:
Know I never want to lose you. I can't imagine a world with you gone.
      But if I lose you, than I lose EVERYTHING.
Please, don't give up, because if you do, I will give up too.
                 Don't give up, no matter what.
